name: emboss-surface
title: Emboss Surface
description: A surface carved by light: raised, pressed in or stamped, with the relief following a light angle you set or the pointer. Can carve just the text.

props.name: variant
props.description: emboss raises the surface, deboss presses it in, stamp is a hard-edged raised plate.

props.name: target
props.description: surface carves the box; text carves the letters only.

props.name: lightAngle
props.description: Direction the light comes from in degrees: 0 right, 90 up, 135 top left.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Let the light angle follow the pointer on hover-capable devices.

props.name: as
props.description: Element or component rendered as the surface.
